game_title: Range Check Bridge – Smugglers' Bay Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Coastal Port – Smugglers' Bay, a hidden smugglers' bay: the dock cartographer must handle jellyfish swarms while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Range Check Bridge: Test ranges such as 10 <= weight < 20 to let only the right travelers cross.
theme: Coastal Port – Smugglers' Bay: a hidden smugglers' bay
core_gameplay_loop: In Smugglers' Bay, repeat each round: Test ranges such as 10 <= weight < 20 to let only the right travelers cross. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the bridge_load value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the cargo hold using at most 10 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The cargo hold reached with actions_used <= 10.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 10 before the cargo hold is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 1 (intro tier): Range Check Bridge
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Check Bridge' (Week 3 slot 8), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Smugglers' Bay'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bridge_load changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against jellyfish swarms in Smugglers' Bay.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The cargo hold reached with actions_used <= 10.
